title: AutoFeatureTour shared definitions: locators and steps

placeholder.description: A placeholder filled in when the tour loads: {args.x} (fragment parameter), {data.x} (fixture data) or {env:NAME}.

locator.description: What a step acts on. A string tries, in order: button/link/tab/menuitem/checkbox/radio/option/switch/combobox/textbox by exact name, label, placeholder, the same roles by partial name, exact then partial text, a name="…" attribute, and a custom-element tag; a string starting with #, ., [ or css= is CSS. Or an object.

anyOf.description: An element by what users see. Exactly one of role, label, placeholder, text, testId, alt or css; optionally narrowed (has, hasText, nth) and scoped (within, frame).

role.description: ARIA role: button, link, textbox, checkbox, tab, menuitem, combobox, heading, row, cell, dialog…

name.description: Accessible name, with "role". Substring match unless "exact".

exact.description: Match name/label/placeholder/text exactly (default false: substring, case-insensitive).

label.description: A form field by its <label> or aria-label.

placeholder.description: A field by its placeholder text.

text.description: An element by its visible text.

alt.description: An image by its alt text.

css.description: A CSS selector. Last resort: it breaks when markup changes and means nothing to a viewer.

nth.description: Pick the n-th match (0-based) instead of the first visible one; also silences the ambiguity warning.

has.description: Only elements that contain an element matching this locator.

hasNot.description: Only elements that do not contain an element matching this locator.

hasText.description: Only elements whose text contains this (anywhere inside them).

hasNotText.description: Only elements whose text does not contain this.

within.description: Search inside the first visible element matching this locator (a dialog, a row, a panel). Nest for chains.

frame.description: Search inside an iframe: its CSS selector, or a list of selectors for nested frames (outermost first).

step.description: One step: an object with exactly one action key.

action_goto.description: Navigate to a path relative to the environment's baseUrl (never an absolute URL in a platform tour). The URL already open is reloaded (a hash route would not navigate).

reload.description: Load the page afresh after navigating (clears UI state a hash-route change would keep).

optional.description: If it fails, log it and carry on (gives up after timeouts.optional, default 3 s). A check marked optional never fails the run.

timeout.description: Milliseconds before this step gives up (defaults: timeouts.action / verify / waitFor / navigation).

retries.description: Rule-based retries when an action times out or its target is not there yet (default: the tour's "retries", 1). Checks are never retried.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion this check covers (e.g. 2 or "AC2"); defaults to the scene's "criteria".

knownIssue.description: A real app issue makes this step fail, for now (from the review). It still runs: a failure is reported as the known issue and the run carries on ("passed with known issues"); when it passes, the run says the issue looks fixed.

waitForResponse.description: Also wait for a network response whose URL contains this (or matches /regex/), started before the action so it can't be missed.

status.description: With waitForResponse: the HTTP status the response must have; any other status is an APP failure.

method.description: With waitForResponse (or mock): only requests with this HTTP method.
